author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বন্ধনীর verb-এর সঠিক রূপ বসাও (Board: right form of verbs, 0.5×14)।

items.q: The teacher wants the students ___ attentive. (be)
items.rule_bn: 'want + object'-এর পরে to + base verb: to be।

items.q: It is no use ___ over spilt milk. (cry)
items.rule_bn: 'It is no use'-এর পরে verb+ing: crying।

items.q: The rich should not ___ the poor. (hate)
The girl was seen ___ in the park. (walk)
Data ___ collected from many sources. (be, present)
items.rule_bn: 'Data' plural (datum-এর বহুবচন), তাই are; আধুনিক ব্যবহারে is-ও গ্রহণযোগ্য।
